# orionbelt_risk_policy (Resource)

How the gateway routes just-in-time access requests. Leave a block out to turn that rule off. Only one per gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The gateway has a single risk policy.
resource "orionbelt_risk_policy" "this" {
  auto_approve {
    max_sensitivity      = "low"
    max_duration_seconds = 3600
    require_mfa          = true
    remote_users         = ["deploy"]
  }

  escalate {
    without_mfa = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_approve` (Block, Optional) Requests matching every condition are approved without a reviewer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--auto_approve))
- `escalate` (Block, Optional) Requests matching any condition need an admin's approval. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--escalate))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--auto_approve"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_approve`

Optional:

- `hours_utc` (Attributes) Only during these UTC hours. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_approve--hours_utc))
- `max_duration_seconds` (Number)
- `max_sensitivity` (String) Highest machine sensitivity that can be auto-approved: low or medium.
- `remote_users` (List of String) The only remote accounts that may be auto-approved.
- `require_mfa` (Boolean)
- `source_cidrs` (List of String) Only from these networks.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_approve--hours_utc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_approve.hours_utc`

Required:

- `end` (Number)
- `start` (Number)



<a id="nestedblock--escalate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalate`

Optional:

- `outside_hours_utc` (Attributes) Escalate outside these UTC hours. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--escalate--outside_hours_utc))
- `sensitivities` (List of String)
- `source_outside_cidrs` (List of String)
- `without_mfa` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--escalate--outside_hours_utc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalate.outside_hours_utc`

Required:

- `end` (Number)
- `start` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The policy is a singleton; any ID imports it.
terraform import orionbelt_risk_policy.this risk-policy
```
